#!/bin/sh
set -eu
# Kathara: interfacce gia attive, solo IPv4 e routing statico.
ip -4 address show dev eth0 | grep -Fq 'inet 10.14.1.11/24 ' || ip address add 10.14.1.11/24 dev eth0

ip route replace default via 10.14.1.1 dev eth0

# ARP statico limitato ai vicini sul medesimo dominio L2.
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.1 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:01 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.12 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:03 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.13 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:04 nud permanent dev eth0
ip -4 neigh replace 10.14.1.14 lladdr 02:00:00:0a:01:05 nud permanent dev eth0

# Stabilizzazione del gateway (massimo 8 tentativi, mai fatale).
probe_attempt=0
while [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ]; do
    if ping -n -I eth0 -c 1 -W 1 10.14.1.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        break
    fi
    probe_attempt=$((probe_attempt + 1))
    [ "$probe_attempt" -lt 8 ] || break
    sleep 1
done

/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
zones = [('.',1,'10.14.1.11'),('com',2,'10.14.1.12'),('net',3,'10.14.1.13'),('example.com',4,'10.14.1.14'),('service.com',5,'10.14.2.11'),('lab.net',6,'10.14.2.12'),('tools.net',7,'10.14.2.13'),('shop.example.com',8,'10.14.3.11'),('api.service.com',9,'10.14.3.12'),('research.lab.net',10,'10.14.3.13'),('ci.tools.net',11,'10.14.4.11'),('ai.research.lab.net',12,'10.14.4.12'),('data.research.lab.net',13,'10.14.4.13')]
for zone, pc, ip in zones:
    p=Path(f'pc{pc}/etc/bind'); p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    ns='a.root-servers.' if zone=='.' else f'ns.{zone}.'
    filename='db.root' if zone=='.' else f'db.{zone}'
    (p/'named.conf').write_text(f'options {{\\n    directory \"/var/cache/bind\";\\n    recursion no;\\n    allow-query {{ any; }};\\n    dnssec-validation no;\\n    listen-on {{ any; }};\\n    listen-on-v6 {{ none; }};\\n}};\\nzone \"{zone}\" {{ type master; file \"/etc/bind/{filename}\"; }};\\n')
    contact='hostmaster.' if zone=='.' else f'hostmaster.{zone}.'
    lines=['"'$TTL 3600'"',f'@ IN SOA {ns} {contact} ( 1 3600 900 604800 300 )',f'@ IN NS {ns}',f'{ns} IN A {ip}']
    for child, childpc, childip in zones:
        if child=='.': continue
        parent=child.partition('.')[2] or '.'
        if parent==zone:
            childns=f'ns.{child}.'
            lines.extend([f'{child}. IN NS {childns}',f'{childns} IN A {childip}'])
    if zone in ['shop.example.com','api.service.com','ci.tools.net','ai.research.lab.net','data.research.lab.net']:
        lines.append(f'@ IN A {ip}')
    if zone in ['example.com','service.com','lab.net','tools.net']:
        lines.extend([f'@ IN MX 10 mail.{zone}.',f'mail IN A {ip}'])
    if zone=='example.com': lines.append(f'www IN A {ip}')
    (p/filename).write_text('\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n')
    startup=Path(f'pc{pc}.startup')
    with startup.open('a') as f:
        if pc==4: f.write('\\n# Web service for www.example.com\\nsystemctl restart apache2\\n')
        f.write('\\n# DNS authoritative service\\nsystemctl restart named\\n')
p=Path('pc14/etc/bind'); p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(p/'named.conf').write_text('options {\\n    directory \"/var/cache/bind\";\\n    recursion yes;\\n    allow-recursion { any; };\\n    allow-query { any; };\\n    dnssec-validation no;\\n    listen-on { any; };\\n    listen-on-v6 { none; };\\n};\\nzone \".\" { type hint; file \"/etc/bind/db.hints\"; };\\n')
(p/'db.hints').write_text('. 3600000 IN NS a.root-servers.\\na.root-servers. 3600000 IN A 10.14.1.11\\n')
with Path('pc14.startup').open('a') as f: f.write('\\n# DNS recursive resolver\\nsystemctl restart named\\n')
for pc in range(16,21):
    with Path(f'pc{pc}.startup').open('a') as f: f.write('\\n# Local recursive DNS resolver\\necho \"nameserver 10.14.4.14\" > /etc/resolv.conf\\n')
PY"

item.text:
Configured the 13 authoritative zones on pc1–pc13, with 12 delegations and glue records. pc14 is the recursive resolver for pc16–pc20, using pc1 as its root server.

Added the requested host and MX records and enabled Apache on pc4 for `www.example.com`. The MX records provide DNS mail routing; they do not configure mail server software.

The existing images, topology, IP addresses and routes were preserved. Startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, so zone syntax and live resolution still need external verification.
